status_summary: The FY2027 budget request, reported on 2026-04-03, proposes folding the Management Directorate, the Office of Intelligence and Analysis and the Office of Homeland Security Situational Awareness into the Office of the Secretary and Executive Management under one appropriation; CRS puts the consolidated request at about 4.67 billion dollars. The Federal Protective Service appears as a fee-funded line inside that consolidated entity (about 2.03 billion dollars), and neither the budget overview nor CRS describes a change to its reporting line. No merger of Partnership and Engagement into Public Affairs, and no move of appropriations staff into Legislative Affairs, was found.

timeline.event: Reporting on the FY2027 budget request described a proposal to combine the Management Directorate, Intelligence and Analysis, and related headquarters offices into one headquarters office, with a stated saving of 53 million dollars; it needs congressional approval.

title: Put FPS under the Secretary and merge DHS headquarters communications and budget offices
uncertainties: The budget overview copy, hosted by aila.org and carrying DHS's own Fiscal Year 2027 Budget Overview header, prints no date and was read through that hosted copy because dhs.gov is blocked; it has an FPS table line (1,565 FTE and about 2.03 billion dollars for FY2027) and no narrative on FPS reporting. It was re-read in review on 2026-10-18. CRS R48979 was read in part through a summarizing tool; the Management Directorate detail sections and the appendix were not reached. The 2026-04-03 date is that of the Defense One report on the request, as in c05-14; the request's own release date was not pinned. Moving FPS with the Management Directorate into the Office of the Secretary and Executive Management could be read as bringing FPS closer to the Secretary, but no source says FPS would report to the Secretary. The office merger and reporting-line items for Partnership and Engagement, Public Affairs and Legislative Affairs were not found in the two budget documents or in a Federal Register API query (review: one unrelated OPM notice), which is absence of evidence; the December 2025 Council notice was still issued by the Office of Partnership and Engagement. The Intelligence and Analysis, CRCL and Privacy items are covered by c05-14 and c05-15.
